assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE flat seamless tileable GRASS material swatch for a simple32px-tile dungeon roguelike sports field. Moderately dark desaturated natural green, very sparse short grass tufts in small2x2or3x2pixel clusters and a few muted bare-earth clusters, quiet broad flat areas. Logical32x32 pixel art enlarged nearest-neighbor. Limited8flat colors, 2-3shades, low contrast so a beige running track remains legible. Natural worn turf, NOT smooth olive felt, NOT speckled sand, not dense individual blades. Uniform top-down ambient view. OPAQUE rectangular texture fills edge-to-edge, tileable both axes. No border, no ground edge, no fence, no objects, no characters, no perspective, no text, no gradient, no blur, no antialiasing, no photorealism, no bloom.
